Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

AssumeRoleRegion.description: The Region code to use when calling Security Token Service (STS) to assume the PeerRoleArn, if provided. You can update this property.

PeerOwnerId.description: The AWS account ID of the owner of the accepter VPC.

PeerRegion.description: The Region code for the accepter VPC, if the accepter VPC is located in a Region other than the Region in which you make the request.

PeerRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the VPC peer role for the peering connection in another AWS account. You can update this property. To manage PeerVpcPeeringConnectionOptions on a peering connection with another AWS account, the role must allow ec2:DescribeVpcPeeringConnections and ec2:ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions.

PeerVpcId.description: The ID of the VPC with which you are creating the VPC peering connection. You must specify this parameter in the request.
